requirements.statement: For each non-temporal media that has an alternative, the alternative gives access to the same content and to similar functions.

citations.quote: Pour chaque média non temporel ayant une alternative, cette alternative permet-elle d’accéder au même contenu et à des fonctionnalités similaires
vérifier que l’alternative est pertinente (elle permet d’accéder au même contenu et à des fonctionnalités similaires)

routes.statement: The alternative carries the same information as the media, possibly presented differently, and offers similar functions.

citations.quote: Contenu venant se substituer à un autre apportant la même information mais pouvant être présenté de façon différente.
permet-elle d’accéder au même contenu et à des fonctionnalités similaires

rationale.text: The test asks whether the alternative of a non-temporal media gives access to the same content and to similar functions. That is a comparison of meaning and behaviour between two pieces of content, which is judgment: an interactive map and the table or list that replaces it can only be compared by someone who uses both. No axe rule is tagged for this test and no deterministic check can decide it, so there are no links and the entry stays at none. Criterion 4.9 has no particular cases. Applicability is judgment: whether an element is a non-temporal media and whether it has an alternative cannot be decided from the markup. Needs lists state: the functions of a non-temporal media and an in-page alternative often show only after interaction.
